title: Polo G - The Goat Album Cover
coreRelationships: The central figure is dominant and sharply focused, contrasting with the faded, ethereal background figures.
The text elements are integrated into the dark aesthetic, with 'THE GOAT' being a prominent, textured title.
The composition uses a triangular arrangement of faces, with the main subject at the apex.
The color palette is almost entirely grayscale, with subtle warm undertones on the main subject's skin and jewelry providing minimal contrast.
reuseFormula: Recreate the central figure's pose and lighting, maintaining the dark, high-contrast, and desaturated aesthetic. Generate new background figures that are ghost-like and faded, representing different life stages. Integrate a generic parental advisory label.
